headline: Strategic Fronts Exchange Bases at Fevered Pace
war_summary: The latest returns show the contest has sharpened markedly in several sectors since the previous edition. FishermansRowHex is now the busiest front, with six strategic-base events in the past two hours and thirty-six over the day; its line stands at seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base. StlicanShelfHex has likewise erupted, recording eight events in two hours and thirty-three in twenty-four, with six Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanseHex remains intensely fought, its daily tally at twenty-nine and two fresh events, while ownership sits at five Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. MooringCountyHex has recorded three recent events and sixteen across the day, holding eleven Warden bases to one Colonial. StonecradleHex is quieter at present but remains divided five to four after fourteen daily events. LinnMercyHex has seen no event in the latest two hours, yet thirteen across the day leave one Warden base amid ten Colonial-held positions. Other sectors show little or no strategic movement.
